name.doc: What the store and the confirmation call it.

description.doc: One line under the name: what it is for.

sprite.doc: Its art: render/assets/<sprite>.png. The Gems or Bag icon stands in until the file lands.

shelf.doc: Where it is sold (Docs/features/14-monetization.md §2). gems: the Gem pack grid, Gems and nothing else. bag: the Bag's bundles, always on sale. offer: a pack that opens on `opensOn`, with its own window and limit. daily: the pool the day's offers are drawn from. survey: the Survey's paid column, sold on the Survey.

priceUsd.doc: Dollars, as displayed and as deducted from the monthly budget.

items.doc: What it puts in the Bag.

hero.doc: A hero it hands over. One already held pays the golden banner's duplicate fragments instead.

builders.doc: Builders it hires for good. Held back from sale while the crew is at its ceiling.

explorers.doc: Explorers it adds on the world map for good. Held back from sale at the ceiling.

heroSlots.doc: Hero slots it opens in every party for good. Held back from sale at the ceiling.

nextDayGems.doc: Gems it hands over the day after it is bought, claimed by the player.

nextDayHeroXp.doc: Hero XP it hands over the day after.

nextDayFragments.doc: Fragments of its `hero` it hands over the day after.

nextDayItems.doc: Items it hands over the day after.

opensOn.doc: An offer: what opens its window. always: from the start. door: when `door` opens. after: when `after` is bought. townhall: every Townhall level from `townhall` on. manaLow: the pool below the ad threshold. buildersBusy: a build refused for want of a builder. The last three open again once the window has closed and `cooldownHours` have passed.

door.doc: opensOn door: the door that opens it (sim/doors.ts).

after.doc: opensOn after: the offer whose purchase opens this one — the next step of a chain.

townhall.doc: The Townhall level it waits for. opensOn townhall: the first level that opens it. daily: the level it joins the pool at.

hours.doc: How long its window stays open. 0: until it is bought out.

limit.doc: How many a window sells (a daily: a day). 0: no limit.

cooldownHours.doc: manaLow, buildersBusy, townhall: hours after a window closes before the trigger can open it again.

splash.doc: An offer shown full screen at the start of every session while it is on sale, from the session after its window opened.

widget.doc: An offer shown as a floating icon on the map, under the Survey, while it is on sale or its next-day part waits; a tap opens its splash. Its icon is `sprite`.
